name: l-frii.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: l-frii.com scores 73 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 31 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (1 request), Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies __cf_bm on onesignal.com, _ga_QF7CME46X3, _ga, AU on ftd.agency.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Inline text spacing must be adjustable with custom stylesheets
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /, /reussite, for example body > div:nth-child(28). Impact: serious.

fix.title: 10 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /actualites, /reussite, /opportunites, /urban and 6 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 443 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
